traceability.notes: docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md is a concrete user story/spec for error reporting behavior across the plugin’s rules. The implementation matches the described conventions: each validation rule defines clear meta.messages with structured placeholders, rules provide function- and branch-specific messages (including examples and suggested actions), plugin configs map rules to appropriate severities (errors for missing annotations/references, warning for format issues), and helper modules centralize core error-reporting behavior and edge-case handling. Multiple focused test suites reference this story and its requirement IDs and assert message IDs, data payloads, suggestion text, and error handling behavior. All these tests pass under the project’s Jest run, so the story’s core functionality, UX, integration, error handling, and severity conventions are fully implemented and verified.
